title.narrative: The project for promoting youth employment by supporting technical and vocational education in Liberia

description.narrative: The project proposal originated from the expression of interest by the government of Japan to fund a successor project to the UNIDO KOMATSU project in Liberia (SAP 120434). The proposed project will be focusing on youth employment through technical and vocational education. The government of Japan has requested to submit the finalized project document as soon as possible to be included in the upcoming Cabinet Decision. The estimated amount is approximately 200.000.000 JPY (around 1.6 million USD).
